title: Multi-Lead-In Cable Pair Loop
summary: Wiring diagram showing how up to eight detector loops are connected to a 4-pair multi-lead-in cable, with the pair colors and the actuation phase each loop serves. Loops are wired in series in groups of two to four per pair, never in parallel. Typical installation is shown, and two or three pair cable may be used when the signal plan shows it.

sheets.notes:
Actuation/Phase Loops
Loops 1 through 8 are shown along the direction of travel next to the curb line, wired to cable pairs 1 through 16.
4 pair cable colors: blue/white, orange/white, green/white, brown/white.
Drain wire connected to earth ground at controller cabinet.
Notes:
1. Connect two to four loops in series to each pair. Do not use parallel connections.
2. Do not connect any unused cable pairs.
3. Typical installation shown. Two or three pair cable may be used when shown on signal plan.

title: Light Rail Train (LRT) Track Detector Loop
summary: Details for detector loops placed in light rail track, for existing embedded track (saw cut loops) and new ballasted track (preformed loops). Shows sections, 4 turns of wire, 5 inch deep saw cut, 2 inch PVC Schedule 80 conduit 30 inches deep, and the detector handhole and termination pull box. Saw cut loops are for existing embedded track only, and preformed loops are used for all new construction.

sheets.notes:
LRT detector for existing track (embedded)
4 turns of wire. Install detector wires in saw cut (5" deep). Fill slot with loop sealant to within 1/16" of top (do not overfill). 5" max. 2" PVC Schedule 80 conduit 30" deep to termination pull box. Sections C-C and D-D show embedded track, P.C.C. or asphalt concrete, subbase, subballast bed and detector handhole.
Notes:
1. Saw cut loops (octagonal or circular) to be used for existing embedded track installations only. See LADOT Std. Dwg. S-70.1.A for inductive loop installation details not shown hereon.
LRT detector for new track (ballasted)
4 turns of wire in a preformed loop. Top of slab even with rail. Detail A, section B-B: ballasted or concrete track bed, concrete track tie, detector handhole, termination pull box, 2" PVC Schedule 80 conduit 30" deep.
Notes:
1. Preformed loop to be used for all new construction.
2. See current LADOT material specification for traffic loop.
3. See page 2 and 8 for preformed LRT loop details.

title: Pull Box, Types PB-2 & PB-3
summary: Section of the standard traffic signal pull box with a lid marked TRAFFIC SIGNAL in 1 inch letters, set flush with finished grade on crushed rock. Outside dimensions are 15 by 25 inches for Type PB2 and 22 by 34 inches for Type PB3. Conduit bonding requirements are given in the notes.

sheets.notes:
Traffic signal pull box section. 1" letters cast or stamped in lid reading TRAFFIC SIGNAL. Finish grade at top of box (see Note 3). Crushed rock under box, 6" min.
Notes:
1. Pullbox details not shown on this plan shall conform to Dept. of Public Works Standard Drawing # L-201-0.
2. Outside dimension: Type PB2 - 15"x25", Type PB3 - 22"x34".
3. Galvanized conduits must be bonded with copper ground strap around the neck of each conduit. PVC conduits must have their #8 green ground wires spliced together.

title: Metal Cover Traffic Pull Box (Caltrans Pullbox No. 6 (T))
summary: Metal covered traffic pull box for driveways, alleys and locations with vehicular traffic, based on Caltrans Pullbox No. 6 (T). Shows a reinforced steel cover with embossed non-skid pattern, a galvanized Z-bar frame, special concrete footing, bonding jumper and hold-down bolts. Notes cover placement relative to grade, curbs and poles, cover marking and bonding.

sheets.notes:
Notes:
1. Traffic pullboxes in driveways, alleys and locations with vehicular traffic shall be metal covered per this standard.
2. Pullbox details not shown on this plan shall conform to Caltrans Standard Plan ES-8.
3. Traffic pullbox shall be provided with steel cover and special concrete footing. Steel cover shall have embossed non-skid pattern.
4. Galvanized conduits must be bonded with copper ground strap around the neck of each conduit. PVC conduits must have their #8 green ground wires spliced together.
5. Top of pull boxes shall be flush with surrounding grade or top of adjacent curb, except that in unpaved areas where pull box is not immediately adjacent to and protected by a concrete foundation, pole or other protective construction, the box shall be placed with its top 1 1/4" above surrounding grade. Where practicable, pull boxes shown in the vicinity of curbs shall be placed adjacent to the back of curb, and pull boxes shown adjacent to standards shall be placed on side of foundation facing away from traffic, unless otherwise noted. When pull box is installed in sidewalk area, the depth of the pull box shall be adjusted so that the top of the pull box is flush with the sidewalk.
6. Pull box cover shall be marked "TRAFFIC SIGNAL".
7. Bonding jumper for metal covers shall be flat braided strap, 2' long minimum, Panduit Part # BS202446EU or equivalent.
8. Hold-down bolt shall be 5/8" and coarse threaded.
Details: reinforced steel plate cover, galvanized after fabrication, with galvanized Z-bar welded frame, lift hole, hold-down bolt, grounding bushing, PCC footing and 6" min. crushed rock all around.

title: Composite Pull Box, Types PB-2 & PB-3
summary: Polymer concrete pull box for non-traffic areas with a non-skid polymer concrete cover marked TRAFFIC SIGNAL. Includes installation section and side view, cover details, captive bolt and threaded insert details, and a nominal dimensions table for Types PB2 and PB3. Boxes may be stacked no more than two deep.

sheets.notes:
Installation details: top flush with finished grade, 1" crushed rock base, conduits enter through mouse hole knockouts, see Note 2.
Cover: polymer concrete cover with non-skid surface, TRAFFIC SIGNAL in 7/8" letters, 4" x 1/2" pull slots with 3/16" center pin, manufacturer's logo, load rating, recess in cover for hardware (x2).
Typical cover captive bolt (or similar): 1/2"-13 coarse thread stainless steel penta head bolt, stainless steel flat washer, cast-in bolt gripper, 1/2"-13 unified national coarse thread jam nut with threadlocker.
Typical threaded insert (or similar): insert with drainage hole.
Box: polymer concrete box, open base, 3" x 4-1/4" mouse hole knockouts both end (2X).
Nominal dimensions table
Pull box type PB2: min. depth box (D) 12", min. depth extension (E) 10", LI min 1'-8", WI min 11". Cover: TE 2", B 1 3/4", L 1'-11 1/4", W 1'-1 3/4".
Pull box type PB3: min. depth box (D) 12", min. depth extension (E) 10", LI min 2'-4 1/4", WI min 1'-3 1/4". Cover: TE 2", B 2", L 2'-6 1/2", W 1'-5 1/2".
Notes:
1. Refer to Dept. of Public Works Standard Drawing # L-201-1 for additional details and requirements.
2. Galvanized conduits in pull box must be bonded with copper ground strap around the neck of each conduit. PVC conduits must have their #8 green ground wires spliced together.
3. Pull box to be used in non-traffic areas, may be stacked no more than two deep.
4. Stencil TRAFFIC SIGNAL in 1" lettering on backside of cover and inside of box.

title: CIDH Foundation, Type F-2
summary: Cast-in-drilled-hole concrete foundation for signal and lighting standards. Shows a 30 inch diameter shaft with a reinforcing cage and four anchor bolts on an 11 1/2 inch bolt circle. Depth is 5 feet where at least 100 sq ft of concrete sidewalk is adjacent to the foundation and 7 feet 3 inches without it.

sheets.notes:
30" dia. shaft, 11 1/2" bolt circle, 8 1/8" sq. base plate area, 2" clearance.
Reinforcing cage: 26" dia. (O.D.). Total 12 #7 vertical bars, #4 @ 6" or #4 spiral @ 6" pitch with 1'-6" lap at splice. Overall height 4'-6" or 6'-9".
Concrete 560-C-3250. Bonding strap or wire.
Anchor bolts 18" x 40" x 4" (2 nuts and 2 washers required per bolt).
Depth: 5' with 100 sq-ft (minimum) concrete sidewalk adjacent to foundation. 7'-3" without 100 sq-ft (minimum) concrete sidewalk adjacent to foundation.
Notes:
1. Use 1" galvanized conduit for street lighting and 2" schedule 80 PVC conduit for traffic signal unless otherwise specified.
2. Conduit stubs from foundation shall be in the direction of the nearest corresponding pullbox unless otherwise specified.

title: Foundation, Type F-332
summary: Foundation for a traffic signal controller cabinet, shown in top view and side view. Cabinet is mounted on a 24 by 36 inch concrete slab with four anchor bolts, a 3/4 by 8 foot copper weld ground rod, and 30 inch deep conduit. Pull boxes must not be located within the 24 by 36 inch slab.

sheets.notes:
Top view: curb, cabinet mounted rear side of cabinet, 36" slab in unpaved area, conduit to #3 pullbox.
Side view: 3/4" x 8'-0" copper weld ground rod, bushing, 3/4" x 15" x 2" anchor bolts (4 required), conduit 30".
Note:
1. No pullbox to be located within the front or rear 24" x 36" concrete slab.
2. See Standard Drawing No. S-79.9B for grounding details.

title: Over Head Service and Under Ground Service, Dept. of Water & Power, with Service Grounding
summary: Details for connecting a traffic signal to a Dept. of Water and Power electrical service, shown for overhead service (S-79.8), underground service (S-79.9) and service grounding with PVC or galvanized conduit (S-79.9B). Shows the service pole, a PB-3 service pullbox 5 to 15 feet from the pole, 2 inch conduits, wire sizes, a 60 amp in-line fuse and the ground rod and bonding. DWP installs the #2 aluminum service wires and the contractor installs a continuous dedicated #6 green ground to the controller cabinet.

sheets.notes:
Overhead service (S-79.8)
Pullbox cover marked: Service T.S. & S.L.
3 #2 Alum. wires by DWP. Neutral. 6 #6 standard copper wires (12" long) by DWP. 60 Amp fuse in-line waterproof fuseholder for traffic signals. #6 traffic signal service wires. #6 spare for traffic signal (when specified). 3 #6 wires for B.S.L. (see street lighting plan). Bond neutral to ground rod.
Service pole with 2" conduit, 10'-0" to the pole detail, pullbox 5'-0" to 15'-0" from the pole. Service pullbox PB-3, 14" min. One traffic signal service conduit (2"). One street lighting service conduit when specified on Bureau of Street Lighting plan. Bonding wire. Install ground rod.
Notes:
1. Department of Water & Power to install 3 #2 stranded aluminum wires from service pole to pullbox. At the terminus of each #2 aluminum wire the Dept. of Water & Power to splice 2 #6 stranded copper wires (12" long) using compression type connectors. The exposed ends of each copper wire shall be taped when not in use.
2. Install continuous and dedicated #6 green service ground conductor to controller cabinet.
3. See Standard Specifications for Public Works Construction, Sec. 307-2.8.
4. See Standard Drawing S-79.9B for grounding details.

Underground service (S-79.9)
Pullbox cover for combination service marked: Service T.S. & S.L.
3 #2 Alum. wires by DWP. Neutral. 6 #6 standard copper wires (12" long) by DWP. 60 Amp fuse in-line waterproof fuseholder for traffic signals. #6 traffic signal service wires. #6 spare for traffic signal (when specified). 3 #6 wires for B.S.L. (see street lighting plan). Bond neutral to ground rod.
Service pullbox PB-3. Conduit and wires by DWP from manhole. One traffic signal service conduit (2"). One street lighting service conduit when specified on Bureau of Street Lighting plan. Bonding wire. Install ground rod.
Notes:
1. Department of Water & Power to install 3 #2 stranded aluminum wires from service pole to pullbox. At the terminus of each #2 aluminum wire the Dept. of Water & Power to splice 2 #6 stranded copper wires (12" long) using compression type connectors. The exposed ends of each copper wire shall be taped when not in use.
2. Install continuous and dedicated #6 green service ground conductor to controller cabinet.
3. See Standard Specifications for Public Works Construction, Under Ground Service, Sec. 307-2.8.
4. See Standard Drawing S-79.9B for grounding details.

Service grounding (S-79.9B)
PVC conduit system
Note: Use a ground rod wire clamp for each wire (Acorn).
Service pullbox with compression type fitting and ground rod 8 ft x 3/4". Schedule 80 PVC conduit to traffic signal cabinet. Service ground block, service fuse, equipment ground bus in cabinet. Conductors: #6 black AC+, #6 white AC-, #6 green dedicated service ground, #8 green bond wire. Ground rod: 8 ft x 3/4" at cabinet. Utility green from service.
Galvanized conduit system
Note: Use a ground rod wire clamp for each wire (Acorn). Use a bushing on all metal conduit.
Service pullbox with compression type fitting. Bonded galvanized conduit, Schedule 80 conduit. Dedicated service ground, #6 black AC+, #6 white AC-, #6 green, #8 green bond wire, utility green. Ground rod: 8 ft x 3/4" at service pullbox and at cabinet.

title: 34-Foot Cantilever Sign Standard and Foundation Details, and Laminated Overhead Sign Mounting System
summary: Sheet 2 of the 34 foot cantilever sign standard shows the base plate, anchor bolts, drilled hole foundation and weld details, plus general notes. Total sign area may not exceed 180 sq ft, and length B may not exceed 22 feet at maximum sign area. A second sheet in this unit (S-45.0) shows how laminated overhead sign panels mount to mast arms with I-beams and U-bolts, with a table of maximum sign sizes and U-bolt sizes by mast arm length.

sheets.notes:
Detail D: 3"x5" hand hole with frame and removable cover, 1" radius corners. Post. Weld detail. 1"x1/4" backing ring. 3/8" dia. drain hole. Top of walk, mortar, base plate, bonding wire, concrete foundation 560-C-3250, conduit. ASTM A-307 anchor bolts 2" dia. x 32" long with nuts and washers, 4 req'd. Bar 5"x1"x22" long parallel to axis of sign. Overall height 2'-8".
Detail E: bar 5"x1"x22" long, 2 req'd, 2 1/8" dia. holes, 2 1/2" typ.
Section A-A: base plate PL 2"x23"x23" long, 17" bolt spacing, 3" edge distances, 12-#8x14 1/2" long equally spaced, 3" dia. hole finish smooth, 2 1/8" dia. hole, #4 spiral @ 3 1/4" pitch, 3" clear, 3'-0" cast in drilled hole foundation.
Weld detail: backing ring, tack weld, 3/8" and 1/8" welds.
General notes:
1. Total sign area shall not exceed 180 sq. ft.
2. Length "B" shall not exceed 22' with maximum sign area.
3. See plan for positioning of panel.
4. All metal parts shall be galvanized after fabrication.
5. All pipes shall conform to ASTM A53 Grade B specification.
6. Welding shall be in conformance with AWS D2.0 specifications "Welded Highway & Railway Bridges", dated 1969.
7. Tapered tube of equivalent size and capacity may be substituted for pipe post subject to the approval of the Engineer.
8. Sign arms shall be made level by raking the standard with the leveling nuts or other method approved by the Engineer to compensate for dead load deflection.
9. All structural steel shall conform to ASTM designation A36, except where otherwise shown.

Laminated overhead sign mounting system (S-45.0)
Mast arm length / maximum sign dimensions A x B / positioning dimensions C, D, E / U-bolt inside dia. X, length Y:
12': A 14', B 5', C 3' max., D 2.5', E 3' max., X 6 5/8", Y 24".
22': A 18', B 5', C 3' max., D 2.5', E 3' max., X 8 5/8", Y 28".
34' (two arms): A 30', B 6', C 3' max., D 1.5', E 3' max., X 10 1/4", Y 34".
I-beams spaced 6' max. Sections A-A, B-B, C-C and mounting hardware shown.
Parts list:
1. Type "A" laminated sign panel per LADOT specification 82-052-01.
2. I-beam 6" x 3.33", 4.3 lbs/linear ft, 6061-T6 aluminum alloy. 1 per panel.
3. Mast arm per LADOT Std. Dwg. Nos. S-92.2, S-92.3 or S-98.0.
4. 1/2"-13 UNC-2A stainless steel or hot-dipped galvanized U-bolt (4" thread) with hex nut and tapered washer (ASTM A307). 2 per I-beam.
5. 1/4" x 2" x 6" aluminum straps for each panel closure per LADOT specification 82-052-01. 4 per closure.
6. Aluminum mounting clamp. 4 per I-beam.
7. 3/8" x 1.750" (18-8) stainless steel post clip bolt (16 threads) with hex head nylon insert stop nut and flat washer. 4 per I-beam.
General notes:
1. Overhead sign panels shall be Type "A" laminated sign panel per LADOT Spec. 82-052-01.
2. See LADOT Std. Dwg. Nos. S-92.2, S-92.3, or S-98.0 for dimensions, spacings, quantities, and other requirements dependent on mast arm specifications.
3. All bolts, nuts and washers shall be stainless steel or hot-dipped galvanized in accordance with Section 210-3, Std. Spec. for Public Works Construction (1985 edition).
4. Guide signs shall have a white legend and border made of FP92 Type III (high intensity) reflective material on a green background made of FP92 Type II (super-engineering grade) reflective material.
5. Regulatory signs shall have a black (Scotch-Cal) legend and border, on a white background made of FP92 Type IV (VIP grade) reflective material.

title: Overhead Sign Structure Standard Drawings: Round Pedestal Pile Foundation
summary: Round cast-in-drilled-hole pile foundation for an overhead sign structure, shown in elevation and in Section A. Final grade slope may not exceed 1:2.5 within 5 feet of the support. A table gives pile diameter, length, vertical bars and hoops for three structures.

sheets.notes:
D1 Round pedestal pile foundation. Centerline post = centerline shaft. Final grade slope shall not exceed 1:2.5 within 5'-0" of support centerline. 3" max. above grade. Double ties at top. Vertical reinforcement (see table). Transverse reinforcement (see table). 2" dia. conduit. 3" at pile bottom.
I7 Section A: pile diameter, lap 1'-3 1/2", vertical reinforcement (see table), transverse reinforcement (see table), 3" clear min., centerline parallel to sign face.
A1 Pile foundation table (CIDH pile):
Structure 1: pile dia. 4'-0", length 13'-6", 20 vertical bars #9, hoops #4 at 6" spacing.
Structure 2: pile dia. 4'-0", length 15'-0", 20 vertical bars #9, hoops #4 at 6" spacing.
Structure 3: pile dia. 5'-0", length 18'-0", 28 vertical bars #9, hoops #4 at 6" spacing.

title: No Left and No Right Turn Electric Sign
summary: 24 by 24 inch electric sign that displays R3-1 (No Right Turn) or R3-2 (No Left Turn) symbols using rows of fiber optic bundles, with a visor enclosure and a 14.5 inch pedestrian head sign face. Gives message colors, stroke widths and lamp requirements. Conforms to LADOT Specification No. 82-049-03.

sheets.notes:
14.5" sign face (pedestrian head sign). Visor enclosure. Not to scale.
Notes:
1. Sign shall be capable of displaying the following messages: R3-1 (No Right Turn symbol), R3-2 (No Left Turn symbol).
Message colors: Red - circle and diagonal. Width of circle and diagonal - 1.5" stroke - 3 pixel. Lunar white - left arrow or right arrow. Width of arrow - 2" stroke - 4 pixel.
2. The "NO LEFT TURN" and "NO RIGHT TURN" symbols shall be formed by rows of fiber optic bundles spaced 0.50 inch (center to center).
3. Fiber optic bundles shall alternate between two or more lamp sources so that in the event of a lamp failure the sign shall continue to display a discernible and readable message.
Refer to LADOT Std. Dwg. No. S-63.1.4 for mounting assembly. Sign shall conform to LADOT Specification No. 82-049-03. For housing description, see LADOT Std. Dwg. S-58.21.
24" x 24" electric sign shall include a visor enclosure as shown. Lamps shall be solid state, 7W maximum.

title: Typical Mounting of Type 1 Standard
summary: Elevation of a Type 1 shaft on a Type F-1 foundation, showing typical mounting of a 1-way signal head, a pedestrian head and a street name sign. The shaft sits 36 inches from the curb face and the foundation is 14 inches minimum deep. This is drawing S-51.1.2A.

sheets.notes: Typical 1-way head mounting. Typical street name sign installation. Typical pedestrian head mounting. Shaft-Type 1. 36" from curb. Foundation, Type F-1, 14" min.

title: Standard, Type 7
summary: Pedestrian push button post, Type 7, made from 2 1/2 inch standard Schedule 40 pipe, hot dip galvanized after fabrication. Shows the base detail, 5 inch square base plate on a 4 1/2 inch bolt circle, hole detail for the push button and Type F-7 foundation. Push button height is 4 feet 3 3/4 inches and the post is 36 inches from the curb. This is drawing S-51.7.

sheets.notes:
Notes:
1. Shaft material: 2 1/2" std. Schedule 40 pipe.
2. Finish: hot dip galvanize after fabrication per ASTM spec. A-120.
Hole detail: No. 7 drill, 1/4-20 tap, 2 holes. 1 1/8" drill. 1/2", 6" and 9 3/4" spacing. Push button. Overall height 4'-3 3/4".
Base detail: 3/16" and 1/8" welds, 1/16" and 3/8" plate dimensions.
Section A-A: 5" sq. plate, 1/2" R corners, 4 1/2" bolt circle, 3/4" drill 4 holes, cut hole to fit post, 45 degree spacing.
36" from curb. Foundation, Type F-7, 14" min. Anchor bolts 1/2" x 10 1/2" x 1 1/2" (4 required).

title: Mounting of Type 9 Standard
summary: Elevation of a Type 9 shaft carrying a pedestrian head, set on a Type F-1 foundation. Shaft is 36 inches from the curb face and the foundation is 14 inches minimum deep. This is drawing S-51.9A.

sheets.notes: Typical pedestrian head mounting. Shaft-Type 9. 36" from curb. Foundation, Type F-1, 14" min.

title: CD954 Standard
summary: Tapered steel signal pole with a mast arm and luminaire arm on a Type F-2 foundation, with mounting heights and pole base plate details. Mast arm is 15 feet unless otherwise specified, signal head mounting height is 17 feet 6 inches minimum, and a table lists mounting height by mast arm length. Must conform to Bureau of Street Lighting Plan L-103-0. This is drawing S-51.9.6.

sheets.notes:
Mast arm 15'-0" (unless otherwise specified). Mounting height 17'-6" min. Other heights shown on pole: 7'-6", 11'-3", 17'-6", 30'-0". Tapered steel pole. 36" from curb. Street grade, top of curb.
Detail - side opposite mast arm: 3/4" drill thru, 2 holes. 2 1/4" drill, one side. 9" and 4 1/2" spacing.
Pole base plate: 11 1/2" square, 11 1/2" bolt circle, R=1 1/2", axis of arms, 3/4" and 1 1/2" dimensions.
Foundation, Type F-2, 14" min. Anchor bolts 1 1/8" x 40" x 4" (4 required).
Table: Mast arm length 15', mounting height 22.3' +/-. 18', 23.3' +/-. 20', 23.3' +/-.
Note: Standard must conform to Bureau of Street Lighting Plan L-103-0.

title: Camera Poles (Case 4 Mast Arm Loading - 100 MPH Wind Speed)
summary: Sheet 1 of 2 for 45 foot CCTV camera poles, Types C-1-100 and C-2-100, with top-mount or side-mount camera options, optional signal heads, luminaire arm and handhole. Type C-2-100 also carries a 45 foot max. signal arm with a street name sign. Gives pole dimensions, steel and finish specifications and general notes. This is drawing S-52.1.4B.

sheets.notes:
Type C-1-100 pole and Type C-2-100 pole.
Side-mount option (see clamp and side mounted camera arm detail - sheet 2). Upper handhole and coupling (see detail - sheet 2). Top-mount option (see pan and tilt mounting flange detail - sheet 2). 12' max.
Pole height 45'-0". Base O.D. 12.125", top O.D. 5.938". Wall thickness 0.4184" (C-1-100) and 0.6250" (C-2-100). Luminaire arm 15' max. Heights shown: 7'-6", 11'-3", 29'-6" (both), 16'-0" (C-2-100). Optional heads. Handhole. Type C-2-100: signal arm 45' max., "F" spacing (see Note 2), sign, street name sign (see S-486.0), see Note 3, see Note 4. See foundation detail - sheet 2.
Pole specifications:
Base plate and flanges: ASTM A-36.
Shaft: steel of 48,000 psi minimum yield after fabrication. Design yield of Fy = 48,000 psi in order that Fu/Fy > 1.5.
Pipe: ASTM A-53 Grade B.
Anchor bolts: ASTM A-307.
Welds: all butt welds to be ground flush with base metal. Longitudinal: butt weld by the submerged arc process. Circumferential: butt weld with permanent back-up ring.
Finish pole: hot-dip galvanized per ASTM A-123. Finish hardware: hot-dip galvanized per ASTM A-153.
General notes:
1. Fabrication of the standards, luminaire arms and mast arms must conform to the 2006 Department of Transportation, State of California Standard Plans.
2. Refer to LADOT Standard Dwg. No. S-52.1.6 for "F" spacing.
3. Projected luminaire arm length to be determined by Department of Public Works, Bureau of Street Lighting. Refer to Caltrans Standard Dwg. No. ES-7C for luminaire arm connection detail.
4. Signal arm connection shall be for 45 ft. arm (Case 4 arm loading), as per Caltrans Standard Dwg. No. ES-7F. Shorter arms may be used, as appropriate.

title: Camera Poles (Case 4 Mast Arm Loading - 100 MPH Wind Speed), Sheet 2
summary: Sheet 2 of the camera pole standard showing the upper handhole and coupling, pan and tilt mounting flange, clamp and side mounted camera arm details, base plate, and the pile foundation. The foundation is a 36 inch diameter by 9 feet 6 inches deep reinforced cage with 3 conduits. Wind load design is based on 2001 AASHTO with a 100 mph wind speed. This is drawing S-52.1.4B sheet 2.

sheets.notes:
Pan and tilt mounting flange detail: 4 stainless nuts, 1/4" cable hook welded to inside of shaft oriented directly opposite coupling and above handhole, 4-3/8" dia. stainless steel studs equally spaced on 4 1/4" dia. B.C., 18" from pole top, threads, 2" coupling and bolts.
Upper handhole and coupling detail: 3"x5" handhole rim (1/4" PL x 2" wide) and cover plate. Each cable shall be supported inside the pole by Kellems grips (or equivalent), one at the top and a second at the mid-point. Two 1/8" dia. galvanized steel wires shall secure mid-point grips to the top cable hook.
Base plate 18"x18"x1.75" (ASTM A-36). 4" topping. 3" Schedule 40 pipe (hot-dip galvanized per ASTM A-153). 1/2" U bolt ASTM A-307. 6'-6" dia. detail, 36" thick plate. 3/4" plate gusset, 2 places each side. Base plate detail: 4 holes, 3" equally spaced on 18" dia. B.C. Clamp and side mounted camera arm detail. Section AA.
Conduits: 3" conduit (traffic), 1" conduit (BSL), 2" conduit (CCTV cable). Bonding strap (or wire). Reinforcing cage 32" cage dia., 9'-6" cage depth. Foundation 36" dia. See LADOT Std. Dwg. No. S-52.1.6.
Foundation design criteria: wind load design based on 2001 AASHTO Standard Specifications for Structural Support for Highway Signs, Luminaires, and Traffic Signals. (Fatigue requirements of Chapter 11 are not considered.) Wind speed = 100 mph.
Notes:
1. Bar reinforcement shall conform to ASTM A615 Grade 60.
2. All soils supporting and surrounding the foundation shall be undisturbed natural soil or 90% compacted fill.
3. Foundation concrete shall be 560-C-3250.

title: BSL Poles with Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon Sign Arm
summary: Typical installations of Bureau of Street Lighting poles carrying a sign arm with rectangular rapid flashing beacons (RRFBs), for single-arm poles CD953A, CD953B and CD953C and double-arm poles CD953-A2, CD953-B2 and CD953-C2. Shows W11-2 pedestrian crossing signs, W16-7p arrows, a pedestrian pushbutton at 42 inches and a solar panel tilted to 60 degrees facing due south. Sign arm bottom clearance is 17 feet minimum. This is drawing S-52.1.7 sheet 1 of 4.

sheets.notes:
BSL poles (CD953A, CD953B, CD953C) typical installation. Not to scale.
BSL poles (CD953-A2, CD953-B2, CD953-C2) typical installation. Not to scale.
Tilt solar panel to 60 degrees and rotate assembly so collector panel will face due south.
Sign arm 8' max. from pole. Detail D. Detail B (back to back). W11-2(2) RRFBs (back to back). W16-7p(2). Control cabinet. Pedestrian pushbutton.
Dimensions: 17' min. to bottom of the arm-mounted beacon and sign, 84" to the bottom of the W16-7p sign, 42" to the pedestrian pushbutton, 36" from curb. Foundation details see sheet 4.
